text_block_list.text:
One day, after we've reached a break in
our activities, we decide to use the
coupon we won in
the raffle and visit a
hot spring resort.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
This inn features a "simple hot spring."
This means the waters are effective at
soothing your nerves and sore muscles,
in addition to promoting general good
health.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
They also offer nine different relaxation
services,
including massages and
aromatherapy.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Dinner will be served banquet-style using
seasonal ingredients. The main
course will be
premium teppanyaki
wagyu beef.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: This trip is to show you my gratitude.
choice_data_list: You really did a lot of research f...
You really did a lot of research f...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Ergo, my mission is to ensure you fully
enjoy your
experience here.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It was necessary to conduct thorough
preliminary research in order to
complete this mission.
Welcome to your
vacation.

I head for the door, thinking of hitting
the hot spring first, but Mihono Bourbon
shows no
indication of moving from
where she's standing.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
No. It is not necessary for me to bathe
on this
vacation.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
If you encounter any sort of trouble,
please
contact me and I will handle it.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
This is unexpected, but if that's your
wish, then I
suppose...
choice_data_list: You should relax and stretch your ...

text_block_list.text: I remind her of how hard we've both worked, and that seems to seal the deal for her.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Order acknowledged. Entering
relaxation mode.
Soaking in the hot spring...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Body temperature increase and comfort
of both
body and mind obtained.
Status—"relaxed."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I rate this hot spring to be quite high on
the scale
of satisfaction.

We've got some time until dinner, so I
invite her
to go for a walk so we can cool
down after our
long soak.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Relaxing is quite "pleasant," Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Had you not suggested I "take it easy," I
would
not have felt this wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
No, allow me to revise my statement.
This was not
something achieved solely
through today's
suggestion.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Well...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Over the years I have spent with you, I
have
experienced many moments of
"fun," "happiness,"
and "frustration."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I think that is precisely why I am now
able to
detect all manner of feelings so
quickly.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In the past, such emotions likely would
have
passed over me without detection.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Gazing at the scenery while bathing in
the hot
spring and being shrouded in its
fragrance was
very "pleasant."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
And being able to enjoy the night
breeze with
you after my bath is "fun"
and makes me "happy."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I would not have been able to
understand these
rare and tender
feelings as I was before.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
But now I can, and this change is all
thanks to
you.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I fear I cannot explain it
adequately, but...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
When I am around you, my emotions
come more
easily.

Her expression is much gentler than
usual as she
speaks.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I... I am glad I met you, Trainer.

I sense that Mihono Bourbon and I have
formed
an irreplaceable bond during this
time together.
